pages.text: Ducks floated on the river. The children each brought a little grain.
Bobo held the grains tightly, wanting to call the ducks close and feed them.
Bobo scattered grain by the water. The ducks did not move.
Waving both arms, Bobo ran to the water. Pebbles rattled underfoot.
The ducks flapped into the air. Only one feather floated on the water.
Grain remained in Bobo's hand. The river grew quiet.
Teacher Bau sat quietly beside Bobo, hands on knees, simply watching the river.
Bobo sat beside Teacher Bau too. A duck swam over from the other side.
The ducks came right to Bobo's feet. Bobo offered grain little by little. Beaks gently tapped their palm.
